name: skill-generation
description: Skill creation, polishing, evaluation, packaging, governance, and publishing workflows for Agent Skills.

interface.shortDescription: 用于创建、打磨、验证和发布 Agent Skills 的方法论技能集。
interface.longDescription: Skill Generation packages LearnPrompt/luban-skill and yaojingang/yao-meta-skill for Codex. It helps agents audit, benchmark, create, refactor, evaluate, govern, validate, showcase, package, and publish Agent Skills as reusable assets, with structured reports, trigger boundaries, comparison evidence, validation gates, release discipline, and post-release iteration guidance.
